transition_semantics: failure evidence ladder: episode(non-success) -> observed failure -> competing diagnoses (at least two registered or the outcome is ATTRIBUTION_OPEN) -> discriminating test -> supported diagnosis -> boundary lesson candidate -> cross-context validation

diagnosis revisions are append-only versions superseding without erasure; a raw failure cannot mint a globally blocking impossibility — only an independently verified impossibility blocks reuse, inside its registered scope
instrument/infrastructure causes must be excluded before any mechanism-level attribution (an instrument negative is not a mechanism negative)
